ValidationRule.description: Requires minimum 1st transaction fields when DPA is selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(DPA_Grant__c, 'Yes'), OR( ISBLANK(Transaction__c), ISBLANK(Transaction__r.Lender_lookup__c), ISBLANK(Transaction__r.Loan_Amount_1st__c), ISPICKVAL(Transaction__r.Loan_Type_1st_TD__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Transaction__r.Loan_Program_1st__c, ''), ISBLANK(Transaction__r.Rate_1st_TD__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DPA transactions require Lender, Loan Amount, Loan Type, Loan Program, and Rate to be completed.
